paragraphs: Adelphi University is a private research university founded in 1896, located on a 75-acre campus in Garden City, New York, approximately 30 miles east of Manhattan. Originally established as Adelphi Academy in Brooklyn in 1863, it became one of the first coeducational universities in the United States. Today Adelphi serves more than 7,300 students across eight colleges and schools, offering over 200 undergraduate and graduate programs spanning the arts, sciences, business, nursing, social work, education, and psychology.

The university is organized into eight academic units: the College of Arts and Sciences, the Robert B. Willumstad School of Business, the Ruth S. Ammon College of Education and Health Sciences, the College of Nursing and Public Health, the School of Social Work, the Gordon F. Derner School of Psychology, the College of Professional and Continuing Studies, and an Honors College. Joint degree programs are offered in partnership with Columbia University and NYU College of Dentistry, broadening pathways for ambitious students.

Adelphi holds a strong regional reputation — it has been named Long Island's highest-ranked private university on Forbes' Top Colleges list for three consecutive years, and is consistently recognized by U.S. News & World Report among National Universities. Average class sizes of 22 undergraduates and 13 graduate students ensure personal attention from faculty. Graduate outcomes are equally strong: the average salary for 2024 baccalaureate graduates reached $76,451 — 16% above the national average.

International students find Adelphi particularly welcoming. The university's Colleges of Distinction designation specifically recognises its commitment to career development and international student support. With four New York locations — Garden City, Manhattan, Hudson Valley, and Suffolk County — students gain access to some of the world's most dynamic professional networks. Adelphi's athletics program has also won 19 NCAA Division II National Championships, giving campus life a spirited, competitive edge.
paragraphsRu: Adelphi University — частный исследовательский университет, основанный в 1896 году и расположенный на кампусе площадью 75 акров в Гарден-Сити, штат Нью-Йорк, примерно в 30 милях к востоку от Манхэттена. Изначально основанный как Adelphi Academy в Бруклине в 1863 году, он стал одним из первых совместных университетов в США. Сегодня Adelphi обслуживает более 7 300 студентов в восьми колледжах и школах, предлагая более 200 программ бакалавриата и магистратуры.

Университет организован в восемь академических подразделений: College of Arts and Sciences, Robert B. Willumstad School of Business, Ruth S. Ammon College of Education and Health Sciences, College of Nursing and Public Health, School of Social Work, Gordon F. Derner School of Psychology, College of Professional and Continuing Studies и Honors College. Совместные программы предлагаются совместно с Columbia University и NYU College of Dentistry.

Adelphi имеет сильную региональную репутацию — три года подряд признаётся лучшим частным университетом Long Island по версии Forbes, и неизменно входит в список National Universities по версии U.S. News & World Report. Средний размер группы — 22 студента на бакалавриате и 13 на магистратуре. Средняя зарплата выпускников бакалавриата 2024 года составила $76 451 — на 16% выше среднего по стране.

Международные студенты находят Adelphi особенно гостеприимным: университет получил статус College of Distinction за поддержку карьерного развития и международных студентов. Четыре кампуса в штате Нью-Йорк — Garden City, Manhattan, Hudson Valley и Suffolk County — обеспечивают доступ к одним из самых динамичных профессиональных сетей мира.
